tasks.title: Bootstrap Rust workspace and quality gates
tasks.goal: Create the compilable Rust workspace, toolchain policy, shared dependency policy, CI commands, and empty crate boundaries without implementing runtime behavior.
accept: All crates compile on macOS target.
No crate cycles.
CI configuration expresses the same quality gates documented in AGENTS.md.

tasks.title: Install canonical contract snapshot and protobuf generation
tasks.goal: Place the build-pack contract files into the implementation repo and generate Rust protobuf types deterministically.
tests: schema JSON parses and const version == 1
accept: Generated protobuf types compile.
Changing a contract without updating the lock fails validation.
No second hand-written copy of protobuf message structs is created.

tasks.title: Implement domain IDs, core enums, and immutable value types
tasks.goal: Create strong internal Rust types around canonical protocol fields so kernel APIs do not traffic in unvalidated strings.
accept: Internal APIs can use typed IDs/states without raw string parsing.
Unknown protobuf enum values fail safely rather than mapping to an unsafe default.

tasks.title: Implement stable error model
tasks.goal: Create a single typed error taxonomy usable across kernel crates and map it to gRPC status later without losing machine-readable codes.
tests: serialization tests if error envelope is serialized
accept: All kernel crates can depend on errors crate without cycles.
Retry safety is represented structurally.

tasks.title: Build deterministic testkit and fault-injection hooks
tasks.goal: Provide reusable clocks, ID factories, temporary directories, barrier/race helpers, and named fault points needed to prove crash/concurrency semantics.
accept: Later crash tests can place deterministic faults without ad-hoc sleeps.

tasks.title: Initialize classified tracing and metrics substrate
tasks.goal: Create observability helpers that attach kernel correlation fields while preventing raw secret payload logging.
accept: Kernel logs include IDs needed for diagnosis.
No secret value type implements accidental Display/Debug exposing contents.

tasks.title: Create inception SQLite KernelStore schema
tasks.goal: Create `kernel.db` bootstrap schema exactly once from the inception SQL and assert structural invariants at startup.
accept: No runtime table is silently auto-created by individual repositories.
Only the exact inception schema is accepted.

tasks.title: Define KernelStore transaction interfaces
tasks.goal: Define object-safe/asynchronous transaction contracts that allow the command coordinator to make multi-entity atomic mutations without exposing SQLite.
accept: Command coordinator can perform a representative run+effect+outbox+idempotency mutation in one transaction interface.

tasks.title: Implement SQLite KernelStore transactions and repositories
tasks.goal: Implement all base repository operations and transaction semantics in SQLite.
accept: A failed transaction leaves zero partial canonical rows.
Every correctness constraint is backed by DB condition/constraint, not only pre-check logic.

tasks.title: Implement OS daemon lock and durable fencing epoch
tasks.goal: Guarantee one authoritative local daemon and give all workers a durable daemon fencing epoch.
accept: Two daemon instances cannot both commit authoritative work.

tasks.title: Implement idempotency and transactional outbox primitives
tasks.goal: Provide repository primitives used by every mutating command for replay safety and durable event projection.
accept: Primitives are safe under concurrent commands and ready for coordinator composition.

tasks.title: Implement Command Coordinator linearization path
tasks.goal: Create the sole state-changing command path and prove commit/replay semantics before higher-level commands are added.
tests: fault after commit => replay returns stored outcome
accept: No state-changing handler can obtain a raw store connection outside coordinator.

tasks.title: Implement event envelopes, stream keys, cursors, and sequence helpers
tasks.goal: Create validated durable event primitives and canonical stream-key/cursor encoding.
accept: No durable event can exist without event_id, stream_key, sequence, classification.

tasks.title: Implement EventJournalPort and SQLite Event Journal
tasks.goal: Create downstream `events.db` projection with exact append/idempotency rules.
accept: Event Journal cannot mutate canonical run state.

tasks.title: Implement outbox dispatcher with journal-first publication
tasks.goal: Project committed outbox events safely to Event Journal, surviving duplicate work and crashes.
tests: journal unavailable => outbox backlog grows, commands still commit
accept: No live durable cursor is emitted by this task before journal ack.

tasks.title: Implement durable Live Event Bus and lag semantics
tasks.goal: Provide bounded in-process subscriptions without allowing slow clients to block runtime or silently skip durable history.
accept: Durable subscriber can always resume from the last acknowledged/delivered cursor.

tasks.title: Implement AgentSpec, Session, Task, and initial AgentRun commands
tasks.goal: Implement immutable AgentSpec revisions plus Session/Task/Created-Run creation commands so later runtime/graph logic has complete canonical roots.
tests: run starts Created without silently becoming Ready
accept: Existing AgentSpec revision bytes/digest can never be overwritten.
CreateTaskRun atomically creates required task/run/parent metadata/outbox/idempotency records.
A run cannot become Ready without a persisted ResolvedRunEnvironment.

tasks.title: Implement AgentRun state machine and revision rules
tasks.goal: Implement pure transition validation plus transaction-backed run mutations.
accept: Illegal transitions cannot be persisted through runtime APIs.

tasks.title: Implement transactional RunGraph edge mutation and cycle prevention
tasks.goal: Implement dependency graph storage with serial cycle validation while deriving parent/child ancestry from the single canonical `runs.parent_run_id` field.
accept: No committed dependency graph contains a directed cycle.

tasks.title: Implement dependency satisfaction and atomic ready-run claiming
tasks.goal: Provide deterministic readiness semantics and single-winner run claims.
tests: claim blocked by recovery disposition test
accept: Exactly one authoritative claim exists for a runnable run.

tasks.title: Implement cancellation epochs and subtree cancellation
tasks.goal: Prevent child-spawn escape races and provide deterministic cancellation propagation.
accept: No uncancelled child can be committed using a stale observed parent cancellation epoch.

tasks.title: Implement startup run reconstruction and recovery dispositions
tasks.goal: Reconstruct non-terminal runs after daemon restart and persist whether they may safely resume.
accept: Daemon never blindly resumes a run whose external effect outcome is ambiguous.

tasks.title: Implement effect contract model and conservative policy resolver
tasks.goal: Compute the kernel-effective side-effect policy from port semantics, extension claims, trust, conformance, and policy.
tests: trusted built-in known read-only remains read-only
accept: Resolver never returns safer retry/reconciliation semantics than evidence supports.

tasks.title: Implement EffectRecord transitions and preparation
tasks.goal: Persist effect preparation atomically with the owning decision/command and enforce legal state transitions.
accept: No effect can be dispatched unless a committed Prepared record exists.

tasks.title: Implement effect executor leases and fencing
tasks.goal: Guarantee one current executor can authoritatively advance an effect.
tests: daemon fence change rejects old executor
accept: At most one fencing token can authoritatively progress an effect at a time.

tasks.title: Implement effect reconciliation and Unknown handling
tasks.goal: Recover safely when dispatch outcome is ambiguous.
tests: never auto retry Unknown property test
accept: No ambiguous external effect is silently duplicated.

tasks.title: Implement durable resource reservations and budget delegation
tasks.goal: Persist reservations and enforce child budget subset constraints.
accept: Budgets cannot be exceeded by racing child reservations.

tasks.title: Implement durable one-shot scheduler timers
tasks.goal: Provide crash-safe timers with linearized fire/cancel semantics.
accept: Timer worker never mutates run state directly.

tasks.title: Implement principals, actors, delegation chains, and grant lineage
tasks.goal: Create persisted authority lineage used by every privileged call.
accept: A child cannot construct an authority chain containing capabilities absent from ancestors.

tasks.title: Implement capability and permission engine
tasks.goal: Centralize authorization decisions including joint secret+egress evaluation.
accept: Every privileged coordinator/service can call one permission API with execution context.

tasks.title: Implement immutable approval request/response flow
tasks.goal: Persist approval requests whose authorization cannot be replayed against changed content.
tests: changed bundle/config digest invalidates prior approval
accept: Approval is never represented internally as only `bool approved`.

tasks.title: Implement Secrets Broker and macOS Keychain store
tasks.goal: Provide safe secret mediation for trusted local adapters without global environment leakage.
tests: keychain integration test guarded for macOS/test keychain
accept: External adapter environment contains only explicitly injected scoped secret material.

tasks.title: Implement supervised external process lifecycle and private socketpair IPC
tasks.goal: Create the secure process-launch substrate for external loops/adapters.
tests: unrelated local process cannot race a listener because none exists
accept: Do not expose a well-known unauthenticated adapter socket.

tasks.title: Implement framed protobuf external adapter protocol
tasks.goal: Implement bootstrap/hello identity validation and request/response/cancel/health framing.
accept: Adapter self-assertion cannot override supervisor expected identity.

tasks.title: Implement content-addressed adapter registry
tasks.goal: Register immutable adapter identities and persist trust/conformance metadata.
tests: same name/version different digest treated as different identity
accept: Name/version alone never authorizes execution.

tasks.title: Implement port capability negotiation and deterministic resolver
tasks.goal: Resolve requested port semantics against installed adapters without vendor-name branching.
accept: Resolver returns immutable adapter identity + negotiated capability document.

tasks.title: Build fixture external effect adapter
tasks.goal: Provide a real external process used to prove protocol, effect idempotency, status lookup, crashes, and fencing.
accept: Fixture can demonstrate the exact ambiguity the Effect Coordinator is designed to solve.

tasks.title: Implement logical Resource URI parser/resolver
tasks.goal: Provide typed logical resource references and capability-checked resolver dispatch.
accept: No internal domain record needs an absolute workspace/artifact path.

tasks.title: Implement local workspace adapter and Git worktree primitives
tasks.goal: Create local mutable workspaces with reproducible base revision and isolated fork capability.
tests: Git fork starts at parent base revision
accept: Adapter reports actual capabilities; it does not pretend copy fork is Git-semantic.

tasks.title: Implement Workspace Coordinator leases, transfer, fork, and merge
tasks.goal: Coordinate write authority so subagents can receive useful parent scope without unsafe concurrent mutation.
tests: shared mode rejected by local adapter
accept: Parent can delegate useful exclusive/forked scope while authority never amplifies.

tasks.title: Implement Sandbox Manager and T0 trusted local-process adapter
tasks.goal: Provide trusted local execution plus strict tier resolution semantics.
tests: revoked workspace lease prevents coordinator-mediated exec/write path
accept: Documentation/API reports T0 is not a security boundary.

tasks.title: Implement local ArtifactStore and metadata
tasks.goal: Persist durable outputs by logical artifact URI with digest/classification metadata.
tests: atomic write failure leaves no partial visible artifact
logical URI no physical path leak
accept: Agent-facing APIs only return artifact URIs/metadata.

tasks.title: Implement inception config parser and schema validation
tasks.goal: Load one internally consistent version-1 config model with explicit binding scopes.
accept: KernelStore selection cannot be changed through runtime profile.

tasks.title: Implement immutable config generations and tested activation
tasks.goal: Persist proposed generations and activate only validated/tested immutable documents.
tests: generation-global service change returns DAEMON_RESTART_REQUIRED and does not move pointer
accept: Existing run records are never rewritten on activation.

tasks.title: Implement runtime profile resolution and frozen ResolvedRunEnvironment
tasks.goal: Resolve exact run-scoped dependencies once and persist them immutably before a run executes.
tests: Run A under G1, activate G2, A still returns G1 bindings
DB update attempt rejected by repository API/constraint policy
missing required adapter fails run start before execution
accept: Historical audit needs no mutable current registry/config to know original bindings.

tasks.title: Build fixture external AgentLoop process
tasks.goal: Provide a deterministic external loop fixture that can emit Complete, SpawnAgent, Wait, and InvokeEffect decisions.
accept: Fixture never directly spawns processes or performs privileged side effects.

tasks.title: Implement loop turn supervisor and fenced decision acceptance
tasks.goal: Issue turns to resolved loop process and atomically accept only current decisions.
tests: duplicate decision does not duplicate effect/child
accept: Delayed response from old epoch can never affect current run.

tasks.title: Implement local gRPC server over Unix-domain socket
tasks.goal: Expose the base control plane locally without bypassing internal command semantics.
accept: Handlers cannot receive raw KernelStore handle.

tasks.title: Implement command/query Control API methods
tasks.goal: Expose typed base commands and read queries needed to drive the MVP.
accept: No public state-changing method performs direct repository mutation.

tasks.title: Implement Event API read and live subscription
tasks.goal: Expose durable history and journal-backed resumable live subscriptions.
accept: Client never gets a durable cursor that journal cannot serve.

tasks.title: Build local control CLI
tasks.goal: Provide a deterministic operator/developer client used by integration tests and manual inspection.
tests: CLI smoke tests against temp daemon
accept: Integration tests can drive the full system without internal test-only DB mutation.

tasks.title: Compose agentd startup/shutdown and basic end-to-end run
tasks.goal: Wire the composition root and prove a simple fixture run reaches terminal state through real processes/DB/API.
tests: restart after completed run retains audit data
accept: No fixture test reaches into DB to force normal runtime progress.

tasks.title: Verify hierarchical children and workspace delegation end-to-end
tasks.goal: Prove parent/child RunGraph and workspace authority semantics with fixture loops.
accept: Parallel children remain useful because forks inherit exact parent scope/base.

tasks.title: Verify effect crash/restart and reconciliation end-to-end
tasks.goal: Prove the hardest external-side-effect failure paths with real daemon restart and fixture adapter.
accept: No test permits automatic duplicate mutation after ambiguous dispatch.

tasks.title: Run concurrency and property invariant suite
tasks.goal: Stress every kernel linearization point under randomized/concurrent schedules.
accept: No graph cycle, double effect commit, double timer winner, budget amplification, capability amplification, or double exclusive lease can be produced.

tasks.title: Run security and protocol invariant suite
tasks.goal: Prove the MVP fails closed at its stated security boundaries.
accept: Every security claim made by MVP docs has an executable test or is explicitly labeled non-boundary (T0).

tasks.title: Implement automated MVP release gate
tasks.goal: Create one command that proves the microkernel/base-control-plane MVP satisfies all exit criteria.
tests: execute release gate on clean checkout
accept: All criteria in MVP_EXIT_CRITERIA.md are linked to passing test names/evidence.
No skipped required test is reported as pass.

tasks.title: Implement MessageQueuePort and in-memory generation-global adapter
tasks.goal: Provide the inception queue contract and a non-durable in-memory adapter for internal/MVP uses without making the queue authoritative for run correctness.
accept: Queue payload identity is stable and duplicate message IDs are handled deterministically according to the adapter contract.
No canonical runtime mutation depends solely on queue delivery.
Adapter capability document truthfully reports in-memory limitations.

tasks.title: Implement adapter conformance harness and activation gate
tasks.goal: Run machine-readable port/capability tests before an external adapter can become eligible for profile/config resolution.
tests: bundle digest mutation invalidates prior report
accept: Conformance report is bound to exact adapter ID/version/bundle digest.
Resolver can require a passing conformance state.
An adapter cannot advertise a stronger capability merely by editing its manifest after testing.
